title: Front Office Executive
description:
We’re Hiring \| Front Office Executive
 





 📍 Location: Jhajjar, Haryana
 





 💼 Experience: 1–3 Years
 




  





**Job Role:** 



* Manage the reception and front desk operations.
* Attend and transfer incoming telephone calls professionally.
* Welcome, guide, and support visitors, customers, vendors, and guests.
* Coordinate guest arrangements and maintain visitor records.
* Manage meeting room scheduling and conference room bookings.
* Support guest hospitality and reception area management.
* Handle incoming and outgoing couriers, parcels, and mail distribution.
* Maintain courier records and coordinate with courier service providers.
* Manage departmental stationery issuance and stock records.
* Assist in basic administrative and coordination activities assigned by the GA Department.



  





**Qualification \& Experience** 



* Graduate in any discipline (minimum qualification).
* 1 to 3 years of experience in Reception, Front Office, Administration, or Customer Service preferred.
* Fresh candidates with good communication skills may also be considered.



  





**Skills Required** 



* Good spoken and written English.
* Pleasant personality with professional behavior.
* Good communication and interpersonal skills.
* Basic computer knowledge (MS Excel, Word, Outlook).
